name: smart-connections-bridge
description: Node CLI bridge (sc-bridge) for reading Smart Connections's local .smart-env/multi/*.ajson vector index. Provides three ops — index-status, semantic-search, find-related — using bge-micro-v2 cosine similarity via @xenova/transformers. v0.2.0 MINOR (v0.93.3): external_plugins[] declares smart-connections (brianpetro/obsidian-smart-connections) with required:true — bridge is non-functional without SC's vector index, so the manifest explicitly states the hard dependency. No community_plugin_settings[] entry: SC's own defaults are preserved (the plugin's first-run wizard handles model selection and embed paths). v0.1.0 SCAFFOLD: skeleton arg parser + stub op handlers; real implementation lands in S6.
